verdict.rationale: Kong ships a dedicated Dev Portal that lets developers browse/search API documentation, try operations, and manage credentials, plus a Catalog feature explicitly described as a platform-level home for creating, describing, and governing APIs, AI models, MCP servers, and agents across teams — directly matching the internal catalog/portal discovery story. Documentation covers publishing (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI + Markdown) and org-wide inventory visibility, but evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent/hands-on validation. Missing for 10: independent or community confirmation of real-world portal/catalog usage, and more detail on access-control/consumption workflows for consuming teams.
